parsed.refutation_attempt: The code uses recvfrom(server_socket, buffer, sizeof(buffer), ...). The third argument limits the number of bytes written to buffer to sizeof(buffer) (258). Therefore the buffer cannot be overrun by recvfrom. The subsequent loop prints only up to received_bytes, which is guaranteed <= sizeof(buffer). No other writes to buffer occur. Thus there is no path from the untrusted source to an unsafe write or format that could overflow the buffer.
